title: Festbiss – Video-Ad 15f (DE) · „Meine Zähne gebe ich nicht aus der Hand“ – Tischbein-Narration (re-rolls)

shots.h3_prompt: The dentist keeps both hands close in front of her chest, tracing slowly along the denture with the instrument, while the patient nods slowly until the very end. First the dentist traces the instrument slowly along the underside of the denture while explaining to the patient; then she tilts the denture toward her to show it; the patient leans in slightly, listens attentively and nods slowly, and the dentist keeps explaining with small movements of the instrument. Static camera. One continuous shot from this first frame with the same people, faces, clothing and setting; no new people, no extra hands, no text or logos appearing anywhere. Teeth and dentures stay natural.
shots.rr_why: Invented gibberish embroidered name/logo appears on the dentist's coat chest (faint from ~0.6 s, clearly readable as fake lettering 2.7-3.9 s once her hand moves off it); the source coat is plain. Motion itself is fine.

shots.h3_prompt: She keeps her face turned toward the camera with a gentle smile, only glancing briefly at the flowers, while she waters them steadily until the very end. She stands at the worktop watering the red geraniums on the windowsill with a small brass watering can, lips relaxed in an easy smile, completely at ease. First she tilts the watering can a little further and water pours steadily onto the geraniums; then she turns her head to the flowers with an easy smile and moves the spout slowly around the pot; she keeps watering calmly, breathing easily, while the leaves outside the window sway. Static camera. One continuous shot from this first frame with the same people, faces, clothing and setting; no new people, no extra hands, no text or logos appearing anywhere.
shots.rr_why: When she turns her head to the geraniums (~1.3 s on) her hair changes from white to darker ash-brown grey and stays so to the end (identity drift); watering motion itself is fine.
